Tara (CS): PSA: VerdantHealth dedicated pool verdant-prod rode a sustained saturation wave ~92-96% overnight. Noticed p50 latency blip ~01:35 UTC and small error uptick.
Noah (Ops): ugh. any idea queue depth / what coincided with the spike?
Tara (CS): queue depth peaked 61, 3h rolling avg ~26. They launched a large personalization rollout + a platform validation sweep at the same time. 24h GPU hours +19%.
capacity-bot: [alert] pool:verdant-prod saturation >90% for 10h — recommend: temporary +1 reserved unit or throttle non-critical queues.
Pri (SRE): looking through scheduler logs. several validation jobs with seq_len=1440 started 01:33Z on validation-runner; jobs submitted without preemptible flag. snippet:
```
2026-09-12T01:33:07Z verdant-prod GPU2 load 95% seq_len 1440 batch 4
2026-09-12T01:33:08Z job validation id=val-998 queue=validation-runner owner=platform
```
Noah (Ops): flipping validation-runner to preemptible and adding a soft max_concurrent now. Quick mitigation should reduce queue depth within minutes.
Ibrahim (AM): I'll message the account asking to shift validation window to off-peak and request approval for a temporary +1 reserve for 48h while they finish rollout. Need to include cost delta.
Pri (SRE): PATCH applied: set validation-runner priority=background preemptible=true. Queue depth dropping 61 -> 18 in ~9m. GPU saturation down to ~67%.
capacity-bot: [info] autoscale suggestion: +1 reserved unit would drop saturation to ~50% but adds ~24 reserved GPU hours/day to commitment.
Tara (CS): customer reported p50 latency 160ms -> 300ms and error-rate 0.5% -> 1.9% during the window. tagging renewal-risk for QBR if this pattern recurs during audit week.
Noah (Ops): action items: 1) enforce soft quota max_concurrent=10 (owner: Noah, ETA 24h), 2) keep validation preemptible (owner: Pri, ETA 30m), 3) decision on +1 reserve (owner: Ibrahim/Tara, ETA 2h).
Ibrahim (AM): pinged account infra lead in #accounts-verdant with proposal. Will paste customer ack here and follow up in QBR notes.
Tara (CS): thanks team — will close after customer ack, will reopen if latency/error regresses. :thumbsup:
